$comment: The orchestration in force: its roles, their traits, who may create and mail whom. Code reads traits, never role names; another way of working is another copy of this file.
$comment_roomProject: Where the seats at home in the room sit: a folder in the room home, a project in the app.
$comment_roles: label, profile, icon, count, job: how the setup screen names and describes the role. home "room": above every project, reads all mail, keeps the registry. models: one, or named tiers. progress: a later STATUS starts no turn. briefs: writes briefs and verdicts for the seats under it. briefed: works from a brief. writes: changes the tree. reviews: reads and reports; the reviewers an Owner launches in one turn are one round. rotate: the line under its report past rotateAtTokens. tableNote: the line under its table in prompts.

hq.label: HQ
hq.job: Sees every project and passes your instructions down. It runs on one model.

supervisor.label: Supervisor
supervisor.job: Your counterpart in a project: it splits the work and reports to you. It runs on one model.

lead.label: Lead
lead.job: Runs one workstream: plans, briefs Peers, accepts or rejects their results. It runs on one model.
lead.rotate: This Lead {{held}}. Hand its workstream to a successor at its next quiet point (lead-handoff).

peer.label: Peer
peer.job: One role, several models. The Lead reads each name and what it is for, and picks one per task.
peer.rotate: This Peer {{held}}. Its next task, or its next repair, goes to a new Peer.

lens.label: Lens
lens.job: One role, several models. The Lead picks by the question; two lenses are always two different models.

tableNote.one: The table has one lens model: open one lens.
tableNote.several: Two lenses are two different models, always. More lenses: another model for each while the table has one; after that a model sits twice only on two different angles.

$comment_vars: Prompt placeholders beyond {{<role>_provider}}, {{<role>_thinking}}, {{<role>_alternatives}}, {{<role>_table}}: the providers of a role's tiers except the tiers named.
$comment_reviewers: A seat of another role reviews too when its spec is one of `specs` or its title matches `titles`. stall: the params entry for how long a review round waits for its last reviewer.
$comment_notes: The room's own lines. {{rejected}}: rejections since the task's last ACCEPT; {{candidate}}: this candidate's number; {{role}}: the sender's role.

notes.secondCandidate: Second candidate of this task: one rejection since its last ACCEPT. Should this one fail too, the repair goes to a new Peer with a fresh context (its brief: the defects as failing tests, this candidate's sha, what was tried), and a defect of a kind the first review did not report puts the design in question: `lens` on the design, or DECISION_NEEDED, before a writer continues.
notes.lastCandidate: Candidate {{candidate}} of this task: {{rejected}} rejections since its last ACCEPT. One more rejection is your Owner's call (accept-candidate, step 5): DECISION_NEEDED with what each round found and what one more costs.
notes.upClosed: nothing travels up from a {{role}}: the Owner reads your final message and .seatwork/status.md (WAITING ON YOU rows); write there
notes.pastLastRound: This is rejection {{rejected}} of this Peer's task since its last ACCEPT: a round past the second is your Owner's call (accept-candidate, step 5). Unless the Owner gave you this round, report DECISION_NEEDED with what each round found and what one more costs; the task holds meanwhile.

$comment_routes: Who may mail whom, "<sender>><recipient>": a check against mistakes, no security boundary. Off from a seat to its parent: nothing travels up that way, the parent looks.
$comment_spawn: Who may create whom: role, or role:spec for that spec only. A seat created outside it is archived and its parent told. A role that creates seats owns them.
